answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 32728 Country: India Title: heavy memory loss Question: I am 20 years old n i am suffering frm heavy memory loss so please sugest me any islamic solution to increase memory power if u are sending any ayath please type it in english r give zer zabar to the arabi words Answer ID: 32728 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1000/600/L=1432) You should recite Ya Qawi (يا قوي) 11 times by putting your hand on your forehead after each salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
